rules.statement: An order of abatement in a partition action can be set aside without notice to all parties, making the subsequent proceedings valid.
rules.supporting_quote: In my opinion the failure to notice the parties who should be noticed under section 405 of the Civil Procedure Code is an irregularity rendering the order made without notice liable to be set aside at the instance of the aggrieved party. Such failure can be waived by the party affected by the order.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 405 of the Civil Procedure Code
